Who we are

Excellence is our standard, elegance is our language, long-term advancement is our legacy.

Jordan Legacy is a premium model, talent, brand and events management agency committed to bringing your brand and vision to life.

We represent sophisticated models, dynamic talent and powerful voices, and we commit to elevating every stage, campaign and event we touch.

Our ethos

Every individual and every brand has a story worth telling.

Our role is to refine that story, amplify it and present it so it leaves a lasting impression.

Whether it is a model on a runway, a speaker on stage or your first brand launch, we manage the process and execute with precision, intention, detail and commitment. We uphold the highest standards of professionalism.

JLM is more than a management agency. We curate and manage unforgettable experiences.

Services

Model management

Professional representation for experienced models across commercial, beauty, fashion, runway and brand activations. We build careers, not moments.

  • Commercial shoots
  • Beauty and fashion campaigns
  • Professional photoshoots
  • Events and brand activations
  • Runway and fashion shows

Model development

A structured programme for aspiring talent, focused on readiness, professionalism and progression into our Ready-to-Book Division.

  • Mentorship and career guidance
  • Runway and posture training
  • Confidence building and personal presence
  • Camera awareness and posing techniques
  • Photoshoot preparation and professionalism
  • Commercial and campaign modelling training
  • Portfolio development and test shoots

Brand and talent management

We develop and manage personal brands and strategically grow your portfolio for long-term success. We refine your brand voice, elevate your presence and help you build a sustainable personal brand that attracts the right opportunities.

  • MCs and presenters
  • Public speakers with access to event and stage opportunities
  • Makeup artists seeking industry exposure
  • Photographers growing within beauty and fashion
  • Image consulting and media coaching
  • Brand positioning and visibility strategy
  • Social media and personal brand building
  • Speaking, content creation and event etiquette

Event management

We execute high-quality events that embody your brand’s essence and values, from concept to flawless delivery.

  • Full event planning and coordination
  • Creative concept development aligned to your brand identity
  • On-site management and execution
  • Professional service providers and brand-aligned teams
  • Charismatic models and management who elevate the experience
